風險提示： 以上分析基於所提供的有限數據，且短期市場波動性高，投資決策仍需自行判斷，並謹記「投資有風險，入市需謹慎」。

除錯 SQL（參數已代入）

                WITH IndicatorParsed AS (
                    SELECT
                        date,
                        code,
                        name,
                        CAST(close_price AS REAL) AS close_p,

                        -- 均線解析
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS ma5,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma10') AS REAL) AS ma10,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL) AS ma20,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_ma20,

                        -- 成交量解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.current') AS REAL) AS vol_cur,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS vol_ma5,

                        -- MACD 柱狀體解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL) AS osc,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_osc,

                        -- KD 解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL) AS k_val,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL) AS d_val,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_k,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_d

                    FROM stock_daily
                ),
                PreCalculated AS (
                    SELECT
                        *,
                        -- 在此層明確算出 3 條均線的最大值與最小值，避免 WHERE 誤判為聚合
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 >= ma10 AND ma5 >= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 >= ma5 AND ma10 >= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_max,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 <= ma10 AND ma5 <= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 <= ma5 AND ma10 <= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_min
                    FROM IndicatorParsed
                )
                SELECT
                    date,
                    code,
                    name,
                    close_p,
                    ma20,
                    ROUND(vol_cur / 1000, 0) AS vol_cur_k,
                    ROUND(vol_ma5 / 1000, 0) AS vol_ma5_k,
                    prev_osc,
                    osc,
                    k_val,
                    d_val
                FROM PreCalculated
                WHERE
                    -- date 欄位可能是 INTEGER，而 debug SQL 將日期代入後是文字常值；
                    -- 統一轉為文字，確保參數化執行與直接執行 debug SQL 結果一致。
                    CAST(date AS TEXT) = CAST('20261008' AS TEXT)
                    AND code GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                    AND vol_cur >= 500000
                    -- 均線糾結度判斷
                    AND ((ma_max - ma_min) / ma_min) <= 0.035
                    AND ma20 >= prev_ma20
                    AND close_p >= ma20
                    AND ((close_p - ma20) / ma20) <= 0.04

                    -- 量能與動能指標
                    AND vol_cur >= (vol_ma5 * 1.2)
                    -- AND prev_osc <= 0
                    -- AND osc >= 0

                    -- KD 條件
                    AND k_val > d_val
                    AND k_val >= 30
                    AND k_val <= 45
                ORDER BY code ASC;

總結與優先順序

1. 整體市場觀察：

從這5支股票的表現來看，它們在分析期間（20260908~20261008）都展現了極高的CP值和報酬率，多數股票的技術指標都處於嚴重過熱的狀態（RSI>80，KDJ.J接近100）。這暗示市場對這些特定標的在前期有高度的追捧和資金湧入。然而，在20261008的最新收盤日，多數股票都出現了量縮、帶上影線、外資大賣或K線反轉的現象，這是一個明確的警訊。市場資金在高檔開始出現分歧，獲利了結的賣壓正在浮現。對於短期投資者而言，此刻追高風險極大，應更注重風險管理，等待股價回檔整理或確認止跌訊號後再考慮進場。

2. 5支股票優先順序 (第1優先投資 → 第5)：

2. 大甲 (2221): 均線多頭排列，趨勢極強。但外資單日大賣超，且量價背離，短線修正壓力大。優於浩鼎在於其外資賣超相對分散，且K線型態相對沒那麼弱勢。
3. 強新 (5013): 經歷長黑修正後出現吞噬紅K，是止跌反彈的積極訊號。但量能不足，且外資賣超，顯示反彈力道可能受限，需觀察後續量能。
4. 浩鼎 (4174): 技術指標極度過熱，且外資出現巨額賣超，量價背離嚴重。雖然仍處於多頭趨勢，但短期回檔風險極高，不建議短期介入。
5. 天擎 (6708): 經歷長黑修正後，雖然出現長下影線止跌訊號且外資買超，但股價未能站穩5日均線，且量能持續萎縮，反彈力道存疑，風險相對較高。

考慮到目前市場處於高檔震盪且多數個股有過熱修正風險，建議採取保守策略，控制總體資金投入比例，並僅對經過充分回檔、確認止跌的個股進行少量配置。

1. RSI(6)與KDJ的J值回落情況： 觀察這些過熱指標是否能有效回檔至70-80區間，或J值不再高於100，這將是判斷股價是否充分修正的關鍵。

除錯 SQL（參數已代入）

                WITH IndicatorParsed AS (
                    SELECT
                        date,
                        code,
                        name,
                        CAST(close_price AS REAL) AS close_p,

                        -- 均線解析
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS ma5,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma10') AS REAL) AS ma10,
                        CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL) AS ma20,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(m_ma, '$.ma20') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_ma20,

                        -- 成交量解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.current') AS REAL) AS vol_cur,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_vol, '$.ma5') AS REAL) AS vol_ma5,

                        -- MACD 柱狀體解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL) AS osc,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_macd, '$.osc') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_osc,

                        -- KD 解析
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL) AS k_val,
                        CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL) AS d_val,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.k') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_k,
                        LAG(CAST(json_extract(s_kd, '$.d') AS REAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY date) AS prev_d

                    FROM otc_stock_daily
                ),
                PreCalculated AS (
                    SELECT
                        *,
                        -- 在此層明確算出 3 條均線的最大值與最小值，避免 WHERE 誤判為聚合
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 >= ma10 AND ma5 >= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 >= ma5 AND ma10 >= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_max,
                        CASE
                            WHEN ma5 <= ma10 AND ma5 <= ma20 THEN ma5
                            WHEN ma10 <= ma5 AND ma10 <= ma20 THEN ma10
                            ELSE ma20
                        END AS ma_min
                    FROM IndicatorParsed
                )
                SELECT
                    date,
                    code,
                    name,
                    close_p,
                    ma20,
                    ROUND(vol_cur / 1000, 0) AS vol_cur_k,
                    ROUND(vol_ma5 / 1000, 0) AS vol_ma5_k,
                    prev_osc,
                    osc,
                    k_val,
                    d_val
                FROM PreCalculated
                WHERE
                    -- date 欄位可能是 INTEGER，而 debug SQL 將日期代入後是文字常值；
                    -- 統一轉為文字，確保參數化執行與直接執行 debug SQL 結果一致。
                    CAST(date AS TEXT) = CAST('20261008' AS TEXT)
                    AND code GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                    AND vol_cur >= 500000
                    -- 均線糾結度判斷
                    AND ((ma_max - ma_min) / ma_min) <= 0.035
                    AND ma20 >= prev_ma20
                    AND close_p >= ma20
                    AND ((close_p - ma20) / ma20) <= 0.04

                    -- 量能與動能指標
                    AND vol_cur >= (vol_ma5 * 1.2)
                    -- AND prev_osc <= 0
                    -- AND osc >= 0

                    -- KD 條件
                    AND k_val > d_val
                    AND k_val >= 30
                    AND k_val <= 45
                ORDER BY code ASC;
